propositions: BindingRepository must extract sole ownership of live, retired, rotation, and alert files while preserving exact byte layout, original dictionaries, and serialization format without eager writes on construction.
Save operations must unconditionally attempt rotation persistence before live replacement, retaining inline last_get_pass on rotation failure.
Corrupt live JSON raises ValueError and preserves the file; corrupt retired JSON returns empty, preserves the file, and attempts deduplicated alerting that swallows failures.
Rotation tempfile/write/replace failure leaves rotation sidecar old with live replaced by new bytes containing inline floor; subsequent save calls converge the sidecar from the retained inline floor.
Live and retired persistence failures preserve old state, clean temporary files, and raise; alert persistence failures are swallowed without altering successful state-file writes.
